turns.assessment: All degraded services converge on the S15–S09 lightpath, and och21’s S09 receiver recorded the associated BER excursion. Simultaneous input/output power excursions through every amplifier on S15→S09, with unchanged pump currents and no sustained OCM, receiver-power, OSNR, DGD, or SOP-rate change, are characteristic of a brief physical disturbance rather than an amplifier or receiver failure. The evidence therefore points to mechanical disturbance of the S15–S09 fibre/patch route.

proposals.rationale: This is the common optical section for the affected services. Its five amplifiers all saw nearly simultaneous approximately 4 dB input and output excursions, while pump currents remained stable; a transient cable or patch disturbance directly matches that signature and can produce the observed och21 BER degradation.
